name: pets-p2
description: Pet program Stage P2 (the cat set): a cat corner (cat tree with staggered plush platforms + sisal posts, scratching post, litter concealment cabinet, fabric tunnel) placed on the living-room floor; a wall run of cat wall shelf + steps + bridge at staggered heights; a window perch snapped to a window at the sill (windowBound — asserts snap + sillY); and the modular cat tree opened in the product configurator with a module swapped.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: set-daytime
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: dismiss-hints
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.dismissCallout?.('empty-room-hint'); s.dismissCallout?.('room-editor'); })()

steps.name: compute-room-anchors
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const room = fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === st.roomEditor.roomId) || fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); if (!room) throw new Error('no living/dining room'); const ox = room.origin[0], oz = room.origin[1], W = room.width, D = room.depth; window.__room = { ox, oz, W, D, cx: ox + W/2, cz: oz + D/2 }; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len, width:o.width, sill:o.sill, head:o.head }; }; const wins = fp.openings.filter(o => o.kind==='window' && byId[o.wallId]).map(centre); const inRoom = wins.find(w => w.cx >= ox-0.5 && w.cx <= ox+W+0.5 && w.cz >= oz-0.5 && w.cz <= oz+D+0.5); window.__win = inRoom || wins[0]; if (!window.__win) throw new Error('no window opening for the perch'); })()

steps.name: drop-cat-tree
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([r.ox + r.W*0.32, r.oz + r.D*0.35], true); })()

steps.name: click-tree
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: tree-placed
steps.failMessage: The cat tree should place as a floor item

steps.name: confirm-tree
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); if (st.pendingEdit) st.confirmPendingEdit?.(); })()

steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([r.ox + r.W*0.55, r.oz + r.D*0.32], true); })()

steps.name: frame-corner
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.ox + r.W*0.45, 0.7, r.oz + r.D*0.47], radius:2.8}); })()

steps.name: deselect-corner
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: inject-wall-run
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const r = window.__room; const eps = 0.06; const zLine = r.oz + eps; const rot = Math.atan2(0, 1); const at = (fx, mh, defId, extra) => ({ id: defId + '-run', defId, position: [r.ox + r.W*fx, zLine], rotation: rot, props: Object.assign({ mountHeight: mh }, extra || {}) }); const items = [ at(0.28, 0.85, 'cat-wall-steps', { count:4, rise:0.28, run:0.4 }), at(0.58, 1.5, 'cat-wall-shelf', { width:0.5, depth:0.28 }), at(0.8, 1.75, 'cat-wall-bridge', { span:1.0, depth:0.26 }) ]; st.setItems(items); window.__runC = [r.ox + r.W*0.5, r.oz + 0.4]; })()

steps.name: frame-run
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = window.__runC; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[c[0], 1.4, c[1]], radius:2.6}); })()

steps.name: deselect-run
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: drop-perch-near-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__win; const r = window.__room; let ux = r.cx - w.cx, uz = r.cz - w.cz; const l = Math.hypot(ux, uz) || 1; ux/=l; uz/=l; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([w.cx + ux*0.4, w.cz + uz*0.4], true); })()

steps.name: click-perch
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: perch-committed
steps.failMessage: The window perch should commit (windowBound snap) and disarm

steps.name: assert-perch-on-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const it = st.items.find(i => i.defId === 'cat-window-perch'); const d = Math.hypot(it.position[0]-window.__win.cx, it.position[1]-window.__win.cz); if (d > 0.001) throw new Error('perch is ' + d.toFixed(3) + 'm from the window centre — not snapped'); const clamp=(v,lo,hi)=>Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,v)); const expW = clamp(window.__win.width - 0.08, 0.4, 1.4); if (Math.abs(it.props.width - expW) > 1e-6) throw new Error('perch width ' + it.props.width + ' != expected ' + expW); if (Math.abs(it.props.sillY - window.__win.sill) > 1e-6) throw new Error('perch sillY ' + it.props.sillY + ' != window sill ' + window.__win.sill); console.log('perch snapped to window ' + window.__win.id + ' at sill ' + it.props.sillY + ' (d=' + d.toFixed(4) + ')'); })()

steps.name: focus-perch
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[window.__win.cx, window.__win.sill - 0.05, window.__win.cz], radius:1.35})

steps.name: deselect-perch
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(null)

steps.name: enable-configurator
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setFeatureFlag?.('productConfigurator', true)

steps.name: select-cat-tree-product
steps.eval: (function(){ const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .tabs .tab')].find(t => (t.textContent||'').includes('Cat tree')); if (!tab) throw new Error('Cat tree (modular) tab not found: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .tabs .tab')].map(t=>t.textContent).join(' | ')); tab.click(); })()

steps.name: swap-a-module
steps.eval: (function(){ const secs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .sec')]; const top = secs.find(s => (s.querySelector('.sec-h')?.textContent||'').includes('Top tier')); if (!top) throw new Error('Top tier slot not found'); const btns = [...top.querySelectorAll('button.btn')]; const active = btns.find(b => b.className.includes('btn-accent')); const target = btns.find(b => !b.className.includes('btn-accent') && (b.textContent||'').trim().length); if (!target) throw new Error('no alternative option to swap to'); window.__before = active ? active.textContent.trim() : ''; target.click(); window.__after = target.textContent.trim(); })()

steps.name: assert-swap-took
steps.eval: (function(){ const secs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .sec')]; const top = secs.find(s => (s.querySelector('.sec-h')?.textContent||'').includes('Top tier')); const active = [...top.querySelectorAll('button.btn')].find(b => b.className.includes('btn-accent')); const now = active ? active.textContent.trim() : ''; if (!now || now === window.__before) throw new Error('module swap did not change the active option (before=' + window.__before + ', now=' + now + ')'); console.log('swapped top tier: ' + window.__before + ' -> ' + now); })()
